summary: Thin __stdcall forwarding wrapper. Passes its three arguments to MemoryAllocation_cb20 as (a1, a2, 0, a3) and returns the callee result unchanged. The constant 0 occupies the third parameter slot. Called by HashTableIDResolution (0x00495890) and ResourceFileLoader (0x004F9D60), consistent with a small allocation helper used during resource loading. The packet flags a read of global dword_8AFE64 that does not appear in the decompiled body. The legacy ABI label Short_Computation_Surface_Font_Push_Wrapper conflicts with the observed allocator-callee behavior and is treated as stale.
